title: Milk & Mix — My First AI Game
author: doghousepixels
selftext:
I was honestly anxious about sharing this, but my first game, **Milk & Mix**, is now in alpha! I made it using ChatGPT Astra and Meshy.

I’ve always loved making games but struggled with some technical obstacles. This first dive into AI-assisted development has been incredibly addictive. The possibilities feel almost limitless, and it’s very easy to get lost in the weeds trying just one more thing.

It’s still a work in progress, but I’d love for you to try it and share some feedback!

[https://www.milkandmix.com](https://www.milkandmix.com/)
